title: Symbolic Logic II
description: A modern and detailed scene of an advanced classroom or study area focused on symbolic logic. The foreground features a large digital whiteboard displaying complex logical proofs, formulas, and diagrams. Students are actively engaging with the content using tablets and laptops. The background includes bookshelves filled with advanced logic texts, and abstract geometric shapes and lines are subtly integrated into the design, symbolizing the intricate and precise nature of higher-level symbolic logic.
